articles.title: XRP holders can now borrow RLUSD on Ethereum through $280 million lending pool
articles.snippet: XRP holders can now borrow RLUSD against their coins on Ethereum without selling, through a $280 million vault that had never accepted an XRP-linked asset before.

articles.title: XRP Holders Can Now Borrow Ripple's RLUSD on Ethereum Without Selling Their Crypto
articles.snippet: Flare's FXRP has been approved as collateral in a $280 million RLUSD lending vault, allowing XRP holders to tap Ethereum's lending markets.
